column1: # Moss: every screen tests/ui_render.c draws, by the pattern it is built from (tests/ui_screens.py checks the
# list is complete and groups the PNGs by it). Columns, tab separated:
#   shell   PAGE (header, 4 cards, panel, footer) | LAYER (the PAGE frame drawn by ui_layer.c: the layer's cards, key map and key row) | DIALOG | MENU | NAME | INFO
#   cards   HOME (home_param) | TABLE (PAGES[] ids, the generic loop) | CUSTOM:<branch of draw_columns> | -
#   panel   SCOPE | KEYMAP (a layer's key map) | CHART:<kind> | LIST | NOTE (an empty-state message) | EDITOR:<kind> | STRIPS | -
#   footer  STEPS (16 step bars) | ACTIONS (OCT+ / OCT- keycaps) | GRID (drum page + keys) | KEYS (a layer's key row) | -
